summary: The PR addresses the issue by ensuring the formfield_callback from the Meta class is used in modelform_factory. The change appears correct and minimal.

issues.description: The change might introduce behavioral regression if there were existing assumptions about the formfield_callback being overwritten by None in modelform_factory.
The removal of the loop to find base_formfield_callback could be seen as a style change, but it simplifies the code without losing functionality.
